Two vehicles are proposed to be hired under th is contract a) TATA XENON or ISUZU D-max or equivale nt/Higher version. b) Ertiga/Scorpio/Innova/Mahindra Bolero/M arazzo or equivalent/Higher Version - Five Door, Seven Seater. The bidder shall clearly specify whether the bid is submitted on his own (Proprietary Firm) or on behalf of a Partnership Firm / Company / Joint Venture (JV) / Registered Society / Regis tered Trust/HUF etc in the Annexure -1. The bidder(s) shall enclose the attested copies of t he constitution of their concern, and copy of PAN Card along with their bid. Bid Documents i n such cases are to be signed by such persons as may be legally competent to sign them on behalf of the firm, company, association, trust or society, as the case may be. Documents to

be attached as per the constitution of the firm are specified at Clause 1. General Informa tion of bidder under Instruction to Bidder with PDF attached (buyer uploaded ATC docu ments). 2. All the annexures given in the PDF attached (buyer uploaded ATC documents) must be fill ed, signed, stamped and uploaded. 3. MINIMUM ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA (i) Work Experience: The bidder should have satisfactorily completed* in the last three previous financial yea rs and the current financial year upto the date of opening of the bid, one similar singl e service contract** for a minimum of 35% of advertised value of the bid. *Completed service contract includes on-going service contract subject to payment of bills amounting to at least 35% of the advertised value of the bid. ** Similar service contract means any contract that is so specified by the competent authority. Definition of ‘Similar Service Contract’ approved by the competent authori ty is ““The tenderer should have experience in carrying out work of r oad transportation for Railways/Metro Railway/PSU/Central Govt. or State Govt./PSUs”. {Authority: NRHQ Letter No. 14-Elect/Plg/Similar nature work dated 20.09.202 2}. Work experience certificate from private individual shall not be accepted. Certificate fro m public listed company/private company/Trusts having annual turnover of Rs 500 cror e and above subject to the same being issued from their Head office by a person of the company duly enclosing his authorization by the Management for issuing such credenti als. Notes: The bidder shall submit details of work executed by them in the prescribed format( Ann exure-4) along with bid for the service contracts to be considered for qualification of w ork experience criteria clearly indicating the nature/scope of contract, actual completio n cost and actual date of completion for such contract. Work completion certificate issu ed by competent authority shall be used for establishing the similar service contract ev aluation. Financial Years to be considered for work experience evaluation are F Y 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 &2026-27. (ii) Financial Standing: The Bidders will be qualified only if they have minimum financial capabilities as below: T1- Financial Turnover: The bidder should have an aggregate financial turnover not les s than 1.5 times the advertised Bid value during the last three previous financial years a nd in the current financial year upto the date of opening of the bid. The audited balance s heet reflecting financial turnover certified by chartered accountant with her stamp, signa ture and membership number shall be considered. T2-Liquidity: The bidder should have access to or has available liquid assets, lines of cr edit and other financial means to meet cash flow that is valued at 5% of the estimated bi d value net of applicant’s commitments for other contracts. The audited balance sheet a nd/or banking reference certified by chartered accountant with her stamp, signature and membership number shall be submitted by the bidder along with bid.

Banking reference should contain in clear terms the amount that bank will be in a positio n to lend for this work to the applicant/member of the Joint Venture/Consortium. In case t he Net Current Assets (as seen from the Balance sheets) are negative, only the Banking r eferences will be considered. Otherwise the aggregate of the Net Current Assets and sub mitted Banking references will be considered for working out the liquidity. The banking reference should be from a Scheduled Bank in India and it should not be more than 3 months old as on date of submission of bids. Note: Financial Years to be considered for financial turnover are FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025- 26 &2026-27(upto opening of bid) & Liquidity are 2025-26 &2026-27(upto opening of bid) or banking reference. . 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Name of Work:Hiring of Two (02) Vehicles (One SUV and One MUV) Against Condemned Vehicles on 10 Hrs per day and 6 days per week (10×6) Basis with a Ceiling Limi t of 2400 Kilometers per Month per vehicle for a Period of Two (02) Years at Die sel Shed, TKD. The Bidder may visit/contact office of Sr.DME, Diesel Shed, Tughlakabad, New Delhi for any cla rification regarding scope of work before submitting the bid. i. Two vehicles are proposed to be hired under this contract a) TATA XENON or ISUZU D-max or equivalent/Higher version. b) Ertiga/Scorpio/Innova/Mahindra Bolero/Marazzo or equivalent/Higher Version - Five Door, Seven Seater. The vehicle should be available at Diesel Shed, TKD 10 Hrs per day and 6 days per week (10×6) basis under the Chief Diesel Controller. Contractor shall carry the complete work and comply with the condit ion of contract during the currency of contract. Non-compliance of any of activity shall amount to pena lty or termination of contact. ii. The vehicle shall be under the charge of SSE/MW/TKD or representative nominated by Sr.DME/DSL/TK D for transportation of staff & material from TKD to any location over Delhi, UP, Haryana, Punjab, Rajas than , Uttrakhand etc. iii. The vehicle proposed to be hired should be in perfect working order and fully operational. The vehicle should be year 2025 model or latest and should be white in color. iv. Vehicle supplied by the firm should have valid permit to ply over Delhi and adjoining states such as H aryana, U.P, Punjab, Rajasthan, Uttrakhand etc. v. The firm shall not change / replace the driver frequently. Replacement of driver shall be made only w hen the deputed driver fails to turn up either due to sickness or leave. Absence of driver from duty will be treated as if vehicle is not provided by the contractor. However, Diesel Shed, TKD may utilize the v ehicle by making its own arrangement of driver in case of emergency situation. vi. The firm shall deploy sufficient number of drivers to ensure 10 Hrs per day and 6 days per week vehic le availability while ensuring compliance of section 91 of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 or any other stat utory act or rule governing working hours of vehicle drivers. No claim of Over Time (OT) and trave lling allowance shall be entertained. vii. The firm shall ensure that his staff/driver is not found under influence of intoxication while on duty. Th e driver of the vehicle shall be well dressed in a White color uniform with cap and remain neat and cle an, and in possession with valid driving license with mobile phone. Not wearing uniform may attract a penalty as per penalty clause. viii. Contractor shall manage to change the duty of vehicle driver after completion duty as per roaster. Ve hicle shall be parked in Railway Premises. For outside parking charges will be borne by the con

tractor. Whenever vehicle goes outside Delhi i.e. Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Rajastha n, Uttrakhand etc, toll tax/other taxes/charges whatsoever applicable/payable shall be bor ne by firm/contractor. No charges of toll tax/charges etc shall be reimbursed by Railways. ix. No boarding and lodging facilities will be provided to the drivers & other staff of contractor. x. The firm will be responsible for the maintenance of vehicle as and when required and mai ntenance will be done by the firm with his own expenses. At the time of maintenance the f irm shall provide alternative vehicle of equivalent specifications for the total days of vehic le under repair. xi. In case of Breakdown of vehicle, the contractor will have to replace the vehicle within 02 hours in Delh i/NCR area and 04 hours outside Delhi/NCR failing which a penalty as specified will be imposed on the firm. xii. If any penalty is imposed by the police or any other law enforcing agency for any irregularities, it shall be borne by the contractor. xiii. Fueling of the vehicle to be managed nearby Diesel Shed, Tughlakabad, New Delhi area by the contra ctor himself. Railway will not provide any fuel, consumables etc. xiv. Vehicle should have good external appearance without scratches or dents. Any damage to the vehicle affecting its appearance has to be restored within 7 days. xv. The firm shall provide replaceable seat covers of good quality and the same will be changed once a w eek. Color of seat covers would be decided by the competent authority in accordance to ground condit ions. Also, cleanliness of vehicle (both interior and exterior) should be maintained properly by the cont ractor. xvi. Railway Administration will not be responsible for any damages to the vehicle or injury to driver. It is t he sole responsibility of the contractor. xvii.In case, the firm fails to supply the vehicle within the reasonable time as and when required on the app roved rates, the performance guarantee money can be forfeited by the Railway administration. xviii. The chargeable rates will be reckoned from Diesel Shed, Tughlakabad to the destination point till it is r eleased back to the shed. xix. The rates accepted by Railways will be treated as final. xx. Firm should submit police verification & medical certificate of vehicle driver from a registered medical practitioner. SPECIAL CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT The special terms & conditions laid down are in addition to and in part supersession of the General Terms & Conditions of Contract. Wherever there is a conflict between special terms & conditions and General Terms & Conditions, the special conditions shall always prevail. 1. Period of Completion The entire work is required to be completed in all respects within 24 (Twenty F our) Months from the date of issue of the acceptance letter/start of work. The en tire work is required to be completed in all respect within specified period as laid down in the contract agreement. The contractors will be required to maintain stea dy and desired progress to the satisfactions of the execution authority to ensure t hat the work shall be completed in all respects within the stipulated period failing which action may be taken by the Railway Administration as per the clauses stipul ated in “General Conditions of Contract for Services, 2018” of the Railways updat ed till date. 2. Penalty Various penalties during the contract will be as under: S.N Nature of offence Penalty Amount (In INR)

1. If Contractor refuses to go outside Delhi Area 3000/-(per case/per day) If Contractor fails to supply/provide the vehicle or non av 200/-per hour or part thereof or 2 2. ailability of vehicle 000/- per day 200/- per hour or part thereof or 2 3. Absence of driver from duty 000/- per day In case driver is found under influence of intoxication whi 4. 2500/- per case le on duty In case driver is not wearing neat and clean uniform whit 5. 100/- per case e in color Driver found to be not having valid driving license, regist ration certificate, updated vehicle insurance, polluti 6. 500/- per instance on certificate and permit etc. on check by authoritie s. In case of Breakdown of vehicle, If Contractor fail to replace the vehicle 200/-per hour or part thereof bey 7. a) Within 2 hours in Delhi area ond stipulated time b) Within 4 hours outside Delhi area In case Vehicle provided by Contractor not in good exter 8. 2000/-per month nal appearance and having scratches or dents 3. Rates for Payment / Payment Terms a) The rates offered by the contractor and as accepted by the Railways will form th e basis of payment for such items under this contract. Payment will be done on th e basis of vehicle hours earned. Vehicle to be provided for 12500 vehicle hours (6 25 days x 10 Hours x 02 vehicles). Kilometers ceiling per month would be 2400K M per vehicle. b) All bills in three copies shall be submitted by the contractor to the concerned in charge for the work for the contractual payment. The contractor will maintain a Lo g book / Inspection Check sheet to fill date wise kilometers and hours earned by e ach vehicle which shall be certified by the representative nominated by Sr.DME/D SL/TKD and submit the same along with the monthly bills raised by the contractor duly verified by officer in charge. c) Contractor will give the details of worker deployed for the work along with his full particulars such as Name of worker, Father’s Name, Address with police verificatio n and bank details for payment. Contractor will submit the papers of payment whi ch clears that workers payment has been done as per Govt. stipulated minimum wages in their bank account at the time of submission of their bills for the payme nt in this office. The contractor will also submit proof of payment of stipulated ESI & EPF contribution (as per Govt. rules/norms) at the time of bill submission. d) The bill should be raised and submitted on monthly basis. e) Payment will be made by Sr.DFM, Northern Railway, DRM Office, New Delhi. f) Payment will be made only after certification of work done by representative nominated by Sr.DME/D SL/TKD and duly verified by officer/Incharge. Payment will be made through EFT only. No advance pay ment will be made by the administration for this work. g) GST shall be applicable in this contract as per statutory regulations. Railway shall pay GST to contrac tor and same must have been paid by the contractor to concerned GST authorities. Proof of payment o f GST on prevalent rates must be submitted by the contractor along with next bill. Other guidelines iss ued by the Government time to time, if any, in this regard must be followed further. h) Railway reserves the right to make any of the following deductions: · Income tax 2% or as applicable on basic bill value. · TDS @2% or as applicable on GST. · Rate of recovery of conservancy cess charges should be as per RB’s letter no. F(X)I/95/1/1

dated 07.09.2021 · Any other statutory deduction as applicable as per the orders of the Govt. of India or State Govt. · Fine/penalty as per terms of the contract. · Financial liability on the Railway due to default done by the contractor while executing this contract. 4. Communication Facility i. The drivers shall be given GPS equipped mobile phones with data connectivity by the contractor whic h shall be used for communication, the details of contacts to be submitted to concern in-charge. ii. Addresses and telephone nos. of contractor shall also be given to the representative of the Sr.DME/DS L/TKD. 5. Identity Proof The contractor shall provide identity cards to drivers employed by him / them which will be produced o n demand by officers or other staff of Railway designated for the purpose. 6. Attitude of drivers The drivers employed by the contractor should abide by the instruction of the representative nominate d by Sr.DME/DSL/TKD regarding placement of vehicles and shall not take smoking and intoxicants whil e on duty and behave properly and respectfully to the inmates. 7. Address & Police Verification and Medical Certificate Drivers employed should not have criminal background. Police Verification report is necessary at the ti me of appointment of these staff. The police verification report, antecedent/ particulars & address of th e drivers has to be maintained by the contractor duly verified by him and should be made available to the Railway. Further, contractor has to submit medical certificate of the drivers to the Railways which c ertifies that drivers have no communicable diseases. 8. Performance Guarantee (PG) Performance Guarantee at a rate of 5% of the contractual value shall be deposited by the successful bi dder. The successful bidder shall have to submit a Performance Guarantee (PG) valuing 5% of the cont ract value in four separate parts of 1.25% each of the contract value, within 30 (thirty) days from the d ate of issue of Letter of Acceptance (LOA). Extension of time for submission of PG beyond 30 (thirty) days and upto the date of submission of PG fr om the date of issue of LOA may be given by the Authority who is competent to sign the contract agre ement. However, a penal interest of 15% per annum shall be charged for the delay beyond 30 (thirty d ays, i.e. from 31 day after the date of issue of LOA. In case the contractor fails to submit the requisite P G after 60 days from the date of issue of LOA, a notice shall be served to the contractor to deposit the PG immediately however not exceeding 90 days from the date of issue of LOA). In case the contractor fails to submit the requisite PG even after 90 days from the date of issue of LOA, the contract shall be t erminated duly forfeiting EMD and other dues, if any payable against that contract. The failed contractor shall be debarred from participating in re- tender for that work. In case 60th day is a bank h oliday or office closure next working day should be considered as the last day for submission of PGs. D ecision of authority competent to sign the contract agreement would be final in case of any dispute. 9. Trespass The contractor shall all times be fully responsible for any damage or trespass committed by his workm en/agent in carrying out the work. 10. Errors, Omissions and Discrepancies. The bidder shall not take any advantage of any misinterpretation of the conditions due to typing or any other error and if any contradiction, only the printed rules and books should be followed and no claim f or the misinterpretation shall be entertained. 11. Other Terms and Conditions. a. The contractor will be an independent employer and all persons/drivers employed under this contract shall be his employees and not the Railway employees at any stage. b. The contractor shall submit the Bio Data (Name, Fathers Name, Address, Age, Passport Size photo & E mployee no. etc.) of his employee duly attested by the contractor to the nominated representative of t he shed, before taking up the job inside the shed complex at the beginning of the work as well as in be

tween as and when any of his employee is replaced with new employee. The contractor shall provide I dentity card to all those employees deputed to work, who shall carry out the said work and accordingly shed representative shall inform RPF authority regarding the contractor’s employee having and wearin g proper identity card details of whose have been submitted to the shed representative. c. The contractor shall be liable for the safety of his workmen during the course of contract. It is made cl ear that no claim/compensation would be entertained for any type of accident/incident involving his dr iver. Any compensation however as required under law would be payable by the contractor. d. All other clauses, which are not covered above, shall be applicable as per Indian Railways General Con ditions of contract for Services, 2018 corrected up to latest corrections. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Sr.DFM/DLI payable at Delhi . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C Sr.DFM/DLI . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name FA & CAO Northern Railway Account No. 30788224089 IFSC Code SBIN0000691 Bank Name State Bank of India Branch address Parliament Street, New Delhi . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid.
